segments.name: electric
segments.description: Regulated electric generation, transmission and distribution serving residential, commercial, industrial and municipal customers.
segments.evidence: The electric segment is comprised of Montana-Dakota while the natural gas distribution segment is comprised of Montana-Dakota, Cascade and Intermountain.

segments.name: natural gas distribution
segments.description: Regulated natural gas distribution utility service provided through Montana-Dakota, Cascade and Intermountain.
segments.evidence: The electric segment is comprised of Montana-Dakota while the natural gas distribution segment is comprised of Montana-Dakota, Cascade and Intermountain.

segments.name: pipeline
segments.description: Regulated natural gas transportation and storage services operated through WBI Energy.
segments.evidence: WBI Energy is the pipeline segment and Centennial Capital is reflected in the Other category.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay regulated rates for electricity and natural gas delivered, and shippers pay for firm transportation and storage services under contracts.
revenueModel.evidence: The remaining performance obligations at the pipeline segment include firm transportation and storage contracts with fixed pricing and fixed volumes.

changes.text: In 2023, the Company separated Knife River, its construction materials and contracting business, into an independent publicly-traded company.
changes.evidence: On May 31, 2023, the Company executed the separation of Knife River, the construction materials and contracting business, from the Company, resulting in Knife River becoming an independent, publicly-traded company.

changes.text: In 2024, the Company separated Everus, its construction services business, into an independent publicly-traded company.
changes.evidence: On October 31, 2024, the Company completed the separation of Everus, the construction services business, from the Company, resulting in Everus becoming an independent, publicly-traded company.
